datasets.source: NASA PCoE Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset

soh_percent.definition: 100 * discharge capacity / median of the first 10 valid positive discharge capacities per battery

datasets.preprocessing_status: Positive unusual capacities are retained and flagged. Missing, non-finite, and non-positive capacities are excluded with source cycle and reason in the preparation report. Capacity review thresholds are non-scientific triage flags.
datasets.training_status: Blocked: current low-capacity observations and target reference are unresolved; protocols differ across batteries.

documented_formats: Arbin cell test files: Excel collections
CADEX files for CS2_8 and CS2_21: TXT
datasets.candidate_data: Official page documents 1.1 Ah CS2 cells, CC/CV charging, usually 2.7 V discharge cut-off, multiple cycling profiles, and file collections. No specific data license is stated; actual capacity channels, units, and archive sizes remain unverified until authorized files are inspected.
datasets.terms: CALCE describes the data as open access and requests citation for publications; the official page does not identify a dataset-specific license.

datasets.source: CALCE PL pouch-cell aging data (0-60% SOC, C/2; PL03 and PL10)
datasets.documented_test_conditions: 0%-60% SOC cycling at C/2 and room temperature (25 +/- 2 degC); official page describes full-capacity characterization at C/2 between 2.75 V and 4.2 V every 50 or 100 partial cycles.
documented_formats: MATLAB 5.0 .mat files with MATLAB MCOS table objects

documented_measurements.current: A; positive for charge, negative for discharge

datasets.candidate_soh_definition: For a verified full C/2 characterization discharge from 4.2 V to 2.75 V, 100 * measured discharge capacity / that cell's first verified full characterization discharge capacity.
datasets.terms: The official CALCE page describes the data as open access and requests citation for publications. No dataset-specific reuse license was identified; no redistribution rights are inferred.
datasets.training_status: Blocked: the measured table payloads remain undecoded, so cycle counts, capacity values, duplicates, units in the actual records, reference-cycle matching, and labels cannot yet be validated.

datasets.documented_population: Eight Kokam SLPB533459H4 740 mAh lithium-ion pouch cells
datasets.documented_format: The official record refers to readme.txt; the payload file formats and measured channels could not be verified from the public metadata.
datasets.terms: No explicit reuse license or dataset terms were visible in the official record metadata reviewed.

datasets.license: The source repository states Apache License 2.0; scope over bundled measurements is not separately described. Acquired for local inspection only; do not redistribute.
documented_formats: Weekly dynamic CSV files in two 7z archives (82,723,769 and 93,662,910 bytes)
Vehicle specifications in two XLSX files
documented_fields: High-voltage battery current, voltage, and SOC
datasets.target_definition: Trip distance and energy would be derived from telemetry; not supplied as direct per-trip labels in the documented schema.
datasets.ev_coverage_limitation: Three pure EVs are reported, all 2013 Nissan Leafs; weather fields documented are limited to outside-air temperature.
datasets.derived_targets: Trip distance can be estimated from GPS; trip energy can be estimated by integrating high-voltage battery current and voltage. Neither is documented as a supplied trip label.

energy_consumed_kwh.definition: Negative integral of source HV battery current times voltage over valid intervals, retained only when sign agrees with a decrease in recorded SOC.

speed_integrated_distance_km.definition: Trapezoidal integration of recorded vehicle speed over valid timestamp intervals.

datasets.training_status: Not ready for range prediction: trip range is not supplied, energy labels are derived and quality-filtered, and only three pure EV identities are available.

datasets.license: The official download/documentation pages reviewed do not state a dataset-specific license or usage terms; verify before reuse.

target_definition.definition: EPA combined all-electric vehicle range estimate in the official vehicle table; standardized estimate, not observed real-world trip range.

datasets.training_status: XGBoost evaluated for standardized EPA vehicle/configuration range; not real-world trip range.
datasets.evaluation_split_strategy: manufacturer make groups, additionally joined across makes when model-input signatures are identical

datasets.source: VED Initial-Window EV Trip Distance Dataset

target_definition.definition: Trapezoidal integration of vehicle speed over completed trip for pure-EV trips with >= 95% speed-distance coverage. Estimated at t = 30 seconds.

datasets.training_status: Ready for four-model evaluation (Baseline, XGBoost, LSTM, GRU, CNN-LSTM) with Vehicle 10 held out as test.
limitations: Dataset contains only three 2013 Nissan Leafs; cannot claim generalization across vehicle types.
Target is total trip distance in km, not remaining driving range or battery state-of-health.
